Screen control lets the assistant read and act in an app on your screen. Read this before you turn it on.
Only the app in front, during a request that uses it: the text and buttons on that screen. It does not read your other apps in the background.
It can tap, type, scroll and press Back or Home, but only in an app you approve for that request. It asks you again before any tap on a button such as send, pay, buy, delete, install or confirm.
It never runs unattended or in the background. It does not act in its own screens, Settings, or permission dialogs.
Nothing leaves the phone because of screen control, unless you have set up a cloud model to answer the request. If one does, the text on that screen goes to that model\'s provider.

Small programs that add tools for the assistant. They run in a sandbox with no network and no access to your data.
Script plugins are not supported on this phone.

A plugin is two files. plugin.json says what it is and which tools it offers: an id, a title, a summary, a version, and tools. Each tool has a name, a description, a parameters schema, and a risk of read_only or reversible. A script cannot be a riskier tier, because it cannot reach anything outside its sandbox.

main.js defines one function per tool. It receives the arguments as an object and returns text. Use only plain JavaScript: no fetch, no files, no timers that run later. A call is stopped after 5 seconds.
Example, a word count tool. Its tool is named script.word_count.count_words:

This is a best-effort filter, not a guarantee. It does not cover the following.

Text you type or paste into the chat box. The model sees it and this filter does not run on it. It is your own text, so you can see and delete it, but it is the most likely way a secret gets into a chat.
A secret with no recognisable shape, such as a password written as ordinary words or a photo of one. Anything that does not match one of the shapes above passes through untouched.
A one-time code on its own. Codes are only caught next to a word like \"code\" or \"OTP\", because a bare six-digit number can also be a price or a timestamp.
What the model writes back. If it repeats a secret in its answer, you see the answer as it was written.
What the model works out by itself. Hiding strings does not hide meaning, so it can still reason about the rest of a partly masked table.
Anything already saved. Conversations and memories from an earlier version of the app are not rewritten.
The filter runs when a tool reads something, such as the clipboard, a file you hand it or a page it fetches. It cannot protect a secret you never gave the app.

How the model\'s attention memory is stored: Automatic uses f16 unless memory limits the window, where q8_0 buys more context. Technical mode can force f16, q8_0 or q4_0.
Lean frees the model\'s memory when you leave the app and it is idle; the next message reloads it. Balanced keeps it loaded until you switch models or eject it.

The project ID or name the sandboxes belong to. Required with an access token.
Only if the project belongs to a team. Leave blank for a personal account.
The host name or IP address of your server. Connections go only to this server.
The port the SSH server listens on. 22 unless your server uses another.
The account to log in as. Commands run in its home folder.
Paste the private key (OpenSSH or PEM) with no passphrase. Stored encrypted. Leave blank to use the password. RSA and ECDSA keys work; Ed25519 keys are not tested on Android.
Used when no private key is set. Stored encrypted and never shown back.
Pinned automatically on the first connect (SHA256 fingerprint). A different key from the server is refused. Clear this only after you re-keyed the server yourself.

Minutes without a command before the sandbox is stopped. Daytona stops it when idle. Vercel has no idle timer, so it stops this many minutes after the sandbox starts. A stopped sandbox keeps its files and starts again on the next command. Ignored by Termux and My SSH server.
How many passages from your documents a search adds. Small models do best with a few.
Whether the search model download card was dismissed in chat.
Hybrid also finds passages by meaning when the document search model is on this phone, so a question worded differently from the document can still find it. Keyword matches exact words only.
File name of the embedding model in the models folder. The Documents screen fetches the default. Documents are searched by meaning only while this file is on the phone.
The token other apps send as a Bearer header. Regenerate replaces it and cuts off the old one.
From @BotFather: send /newbot and paste the token it gives you. Stored encrypted and never shown back.
How many matching skills are added to each request. Small models do best with one.
The most characters of skill text added to one request. Longer skills are cut.
After you ask for the same thing the same way three times, offer to save it as a skill. Matching runs on the phone; nothing is sent anywhere.
Fills in the mail servers for a common provider. Choose Custom to type your own server rows.
The address of the mailbox, for example you@example.com. Empty means nothing is connected.
An app password for this account, not your normal password. Stored encrypted and never shown back.
Only for Custom. The IMAP server name, for example imap.example.com. Connects over TLS on the port below.
Only for Custom. The TLS port for IMAP, usually 993.
Only for Custom. The SMTP server name, for example smtp.example.com.
Only for Custom. 465 uses TLS from the start. Any other port must offer STARTTLS, or sending fails.
Where your Home Assistant runs, for example https://ha.example.com or http://homeassistant.local:8123. Plain http works only for an address on your own network. Empty means nothing is sent.
In Home Assistant: your profile, Security, Long-lived access tokens. Stored encrypted and never shown back.

Where web.search sends your query. DuckDuckGo needs no key. Brave, Tavily and Exa need your own key; SearXNG needs your instance address. If the chosen provider fails, the search fails. It never switches to another provider.
Your own key from brave.com/search/api. Stored encrypted and never shown back. Used only when Brave Search is the provider.
Your own key from tavily.com. Stored encrypted and never shown back. Used only when Tavily is the provider.
Your own key from exa.ai. Stored encrypted and never shown back. Used only when Exa is the provider.
Full address of a SearXNG instance with the JSON format turned on, for example https://searx.example.org. The query is sent there. Used only when SearXNG is the provider.
The speed test\'s fastest; empty is the CPU.
GPU backends whose load crashed the app.
Chats, memory, settings and everything the assistant downloaded are removed from this phone, and the app closes. This cannot be undone.
Android stopped the app to free memory. Try again with fewer apps open, or ask a shorter question.
More choices: turn on Advanced in Settings.
In use. Use the phone\'s assistant below to stop sending messages.
the first version your account lists
